subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should configured auto-TTS providers remain fallback-capable by default, or should OpenClaw add/enforce provider stickiness for cases like ElevenLabs so playback never silently switches to OpenAI?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally preserve fallback chains, while the issue asks for stronger provider identity guarantees that can affect existing users and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Add opt-in sticky provider mode
options.body: Preserve fallback as the default, add an explicit strict/sticky setting or command path, and document status diagnostics for fallback cases.

options.title: Keep fallback-only behavior
options.body: Treat the merged diagnostics and provider registration work as sufficient and close this issue as a documented behavior choice.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Make configured providers sticky by default with migration notes and broad compatibility tests for existing TTS users.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in sticky provider mode
recommendation.body: Preserve fallback as the default, add an explicit strict/sticky setting or command path, and document status diagnostics for fallback cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice centers on speech-core provider routing defaults, where this history shows the strongest area ownership signal.
